remarks: Quite possibly the cutest condo in Ventura! Located in the coveted Beacon Court neighborhood, this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers a blend of Cape Cod charm and coastal Ventura lifestyle. Approximately 1,246 square feet of inviting living space. Vaulted ceilings, gorgeous wood flooring throughout, and fabulous natural light create an airy, welcoming feel, while fresh interior paint, updated lighting throughout, and the removal of popcorn ceilings give the home a refreshed look.
